Quaternion From Vector3 To Vector3

Source: R/raymath_functions.R
quaternion_from_vector3_to_vector3.Rd

Quaternion From Vector3 To Vector3

Usage

quaternion_from_vector3_to_vector3(from, to)

Arguments

from

A numeric vector of length 3.

to

A numeric vector of length 3.

Value

A numeric vector of length 4

See also
